subject: Request: short grace bump for trial credits — ClearingHouse
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearinghouse.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@clearinghouse.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Trial credits — small grace period/boost request

Hi Naomi,

Hope you’re doing well. We signed up for Redwood last month to evaluate inference for our document-processing pipeline. The trial credits are winding down this week and we have a couple of longer-running integration tests that didn’t finish because of a schema change on our side.

We’d like to request a short grace bump — roughly an additional 40k token credit or a 2‑week extension — so we can finish the end-to-end test and get reliable perf numbers before we commit. We’re seeing promising latency/cost numbers so far; if the final tests look good we’re ready to accelerate procurement conversations.

Account: ClearingHouse (trial, org id CH-7721)
Current spend: ~12k tokens used, running automated tests at low QPS
Why now: final integration test + demo next Thursday for engineering leadership

Happy to provide any logs or a short call if helpful. Marcus and I are available most mornings PST.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Integrations
ClearingHouse

Attachment: trial_account_snapshot.png (preview of console usage)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Trial credits — small grace period/boost request

Ben / Marissa — forwarding a request from ClearingHouse. Short context: they are a PLG signup doing integration tests; trial expires 2027-05-07. They’ve used ~12k tokens and need ~40k more to finish an end-to-end run that will feed into procurement.

I attached a quick usage CSV and the console screenshot Elena sent. My ask: can we approve a self-serve issuance (promo credit) rather than doing a manual invoice? If so, preferred delta: 40k tokens, 30-day validity. ClearingHouse is low-risk but high upside — engineering team is keen and they may convert fast after the demo.

Suggested next step: Ben, if you’re ok with the amount, please confirm and I’ll send the promo code. Marissa, please chime in if you think we should route to Sales Ops / Finance or reduce the amount.

Thanks — Naomi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: clearinghouse_usage_may_snapshot.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial credits — small grace period/boost request

Naomi — thanks for the context and the usage snapshot. I’m comfortable supporting a self-serve promo for this account, but suggest 30k tokens to start (lets them finish tests and keeps runway for a follow-up). If they convert after the demo, we can fast-track a larger committed arrangement.

Marissa — any objections? If not, I’ll mark as approved and ask Ops to generate a promo code with 30-day expiry and one-time use.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, PLG Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trial credits — small grace period/boost request

Ben / Naomi —
I’m okay with an exception here given the demo timeline and the potential uplift. Approve 40k tokens (naomi’s ask) rather than 30k — be generous on trials where engineering is engaged. Please issue as a time-limited promo code (self-serve) and record the issuance in HubSpot and the credits console for audit.

Notes for Ops: tag promo with deal_id CH-2027-001, record reason: "trial bridge — demo prep", set expiration 30 days from issuance. Also attach usage snapshot to the HubSpot engagement.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@clearinghouse.ai>
Cc: Marcus Holt <marcus.holt@clearinghouse.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credits — small grace period/boost request

Hi Elena — good news, we approved a short trial boost. Details below and next steps: 

Promo code: RI-GRACE-40K-0527
Amount: 40,000 token-equivalent credits
Valid until: 2027-06-02 (30 days)
How to redeem: Sign into the Redwood Console -> Account -> Apply promo code. The credits apply immediately and will be visible on the billing tab.

I’ve attached the usage snapshot you provided to the HubSpot engagement and recorded the issuance under CH-2027-001. If you want the credits applied as a temporary account-level grant (we can do that too), say the word and I’ll coordinate with Ops.

Happy to set a short follow-up call after your demo to review conversion support and committed capacity options. Good luck on the run — let us know if anything else blocks you.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: clearinghouse_usage_may_snapshot.csv, trial_account_snapshot.png
